title: appointment.rescheduled v1
description: FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) — fields are top-level, matching the real producer. Emitted when an appointment's time window or home address changes while the appointment is still live (ADR-37 §18.3, LEY DE CONVERGENCIA; alebrije-mod-agenda-ex 0.0.239, 2026-10-21). Producer: AlebrijeAgenda.Appointments update_with_outbox/2, the single update funnel (both reschedule branches, the panel PUT and the agent's tools go through it), stages the row with AlebrijeAgenda.Outbox.emit/3 in the SAME transaction as the write, only when start_time, end_time or domicile_address changed and the resulting status is not terminal (a write that also cancels, completes or marks noshow stages only its lifecycle event). Only the outbox relay publishes it — there is no direct XADD for this event — to the canonical stream 'events:agenda' (Outbox @stream_routes). The envelope is Outbox.envelope_for/2: the base keys every outbox appointment event carries (event_type, appointment_id, tenant_id, calendar_id, contact_phone, status, plus contact_id and person_id only when not blank) and, for this event only, start_time, end_time, domicile_address, service_type and context_id. Idempotency key on the outbox row: 'appointment.rescheduled:<appointment_id>:<updated_at ISO 8601>', one event per write. Consumer: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex AgendaCancellationConsumer (group field-ops-ex-agenda) moves the home-draw order to the new time and address (Mirrors.Appointments.follow_order/3); its reconciler converges anything the live path missed within 30 minutes.

event_type.description: Canonical event_type stamped by Outbox.envelope_for/2. Consumers route on this exact value.

appointment_id.description: UUID of the moved appointment, stringified from appointment.id.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the appointment (ADR-25 tenant scoping).

calendar_id.description: Calendar the appointment belongs to; empty string when absent.

contact_id.description: CRM contact the appointment is for. Omitted (never present-and-empty) when the appointment has no contact.

contact_phone.description: E.164 contact phone carried on the appointment; empty string when absent.

person_id.description: ADR-143 B5 sub-profile anchor. Present only when the appointment is anchored to a non-titular person.

status.description: Appointment status after the write. Never cancelled, completed or noshow: those writes stage only their lifecycle event.

start_time.description: New scheduled start, ISO 8601 with offset (DateTime.to_iso8601/1), e.g. 2026-10-21T16:00:00.000000Z.

end_time.description: New scheduled end, ISO 8601 with offset. Reschedule keeps the appointment's own duration.

domicile_address.description: Home address as agenda stores it: JSON text (a decoded map is encoded back), or an empty string when the appointment has none. Consumers compare it by content, not by key order.

service_type.description: Service booked on the appointment (e.g. lab_domicile); empty string when absent.

context_id.description: Context (vertical/branch) the appointment belongs to; empty string when absent.
